facts.text: hot food at last, aboard the drifting station
facts.why: The station scenes in the pages read show no meal and no hot food. The katsu curry has no source in the plot.
facts.fix: a proper meal at last, before the station turns on them

vibe.verdict: Cold, grim colony canteen with Andy's jokes and Rain's sun dream in the right places, but the big set pieces are missing.
missing: Z-01, the acid blood fluid that wrecks the gravity (the zero-gravity fight)
Andy's real joke: 'Did you hear about the claustrophobic astronaut? He needed space.'
Rook, the reanimated Ash model, at the lab
The Navarro chestburster and the hybrid at the end
The facehugger loose in the cryo bay
ideas: Swap the Andy note on 'Andy's corny corn fritters' for his real joke about the claustrophobic astronaut needing space.
Swap 'Cryo bay frozen lime slushie' note for 'Handle with care. Z-01 burns.'
Swap 'Cheese and onion potato cakes' on the house list for 'Rook's ration, served with a bad conscience'.
Swap the 'Hot cocoa with powdered milk' note for a line about the zero-gravity fight.
